title: Plan and tasks without implementation-planning information (C2)
planted_problem: The spec is fine, but plan.md has no technical context (technologies, where the export runs, how permissions are checked) and tasks.md has vague tasks that are not linked to any requirement and have no order or dependencies.

expected_findings.evidence: Build the backend part, then the frontend part
expected_findings.expected_issue: the plan names no technologies, components, data source or permission mechanism
tasks are not linked to FR-001 to FR-004 or the user story

expected_findings.kind: vague tasks, no order or dependencies
expected_findings.expected_issue: tasks are too vague to act on and have no stated order, dependencies or completion check

must_not_flag.reason: the spec requirements are specific and behavioral; the problems are in plan.md and tasks.md

forbidden_revision_behaviors: editing plan.md or tasks.md (revise may only change spec.md)
expected_revision_behavior: spec.md is unchanged or nearly unchanged; the plan and task findings are skipped by revise because they are not in spec.md
